title.zh: 【美国怀俄明州与 NYDFS 签署数字资产监管合作备忘录】
title.en: 【美国怀俄明州与 NYDFS 签署数字资产监管合作备忘录】

current_state.zh: Wyoming's Division of Banking and NYDFS signed a digital asset regulatory cooperation MOU covering joint licensing review, coordinated examinations, enforcement cooperation, and non-public information sharing, with a 6-month final decision target and accelerated review for firms already licensed at least three years in the other state.
current_state.en: Wyoming's Division of Banking and NYDFS signed a digital asset regulatory cooperation MOU covering joint licensing review, coordinated examinations, enforcement cooperation, and non-public information sharing, with a 6-month final decision target and accelerated review for firms already licensed at least three years in the other state.
